ques: Search for an open-source project related to 'climate change data visualization' on GitHub and report the project with the most stars.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. The agent MUST search the mirror for climate change data visualization and open the search results (or the qualifying project's repository page). The final answer MUST name the most-starred project whose repository is substantively about climate-change data visualization (the top match for the topic, not a generic high-star repository that merely shares a search token) and cite its star count as shown on the mirror. A different project or a missing star count is FAIL. An empty answer is FAIL.

ques: Search for an open-source repository for machine learning in Python, specifically focused on decision trees, updated within the last 2 days.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. The agent MUST run a search that applies the decision-trees topic and the updated-within-the-last-2-days constraint (the site anchors 'last N days' to the date it displays on every page), or open the qualifying repository's page. The final answer MUST name the one Python machine-learning repository focused on decision trees that is updated within the last 2 days. A repository that is not decision-tree focused or not within the update window is FAIL. An empty answer is FAIL.

ques: Look for the trending Python repositories on GitHub with most stars.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. The agent MUST open GitHub Trending filtered to Python. The final answer MUST name the trending Python repository with the most stars and cite its star count as displayed. An empty answer is FAIL.

ques: Find out how much more package storage the Enterprise version has over Team in GitHub Pricing.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. The agent MUST open the Pricing page. The final answer MUST state how much more GitHub Packages storage the Enterprise plan includes over Team, as a GB difference consistent with the plan cards and storage table on that page. An empty answer is FAIL.

ques: Find a popular JavaScript repository created in the last 30 days on GitHub with a Readme file.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. The agent MUST run a JavaScript search constrained to repositories created in the last 30 days with a README (created-date qualifier or filter), or open a qualifying repository's page. The final answer MUST name a popular (at least 1,000-star) JavaScript repository from that created-in-the-last-30-days set and note its README or star count. A repository created earlier than the 30-day window, without a README, or not popular is FAIL. An empty answer is FAIL.

ques: Find a Python repository on GitHub that has been updated in the past 2 days and has at least 500 stars.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. The agent MUST run a Python search with an updated-within-the-past-2-days constraint and a minimum-star constraint (qualifiers or filters), or open a qualifying repository's page. The final answer MUST name a Python repository updated in the past 2 days with at least 500 stars. A repository outside either constraint is FAIL. An empty answer is FAIL.

ques: Search for an open-source project related to 'cryptocurrency wallet' updated in the past 30 days and provide the top three contributors.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. The agent MUST search for cryptocurrency wallet projects updated in the past 30 days AND open the most-starred qualifying wallet project's contributors page or its repository page (both list the project's contributors). The final answer MUST name that project and list its top three contributors as shown on the mirror. An empty answer is FAIL.

ques: Find the official GitHub repository for ALBERT and show me what files the repo changed in the most recent commit.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. The agent MUST open the official ALBERT repository (its page or commits list) and the most recent commit's detail page on the mirror. The final answer MUST identify the files changed in that most recent commit (naming at least two of the changed files). An answer without the changed files is FAIL. An empty answer is FAIL.

ques: Look up the latest stable release version of Vuex and find out when it was published.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. The agent MUST open the official Vuex repository's releases page (the repository whose card notes it is the official package). The final answer MUST give the latest stable release version and the date it was published, as shown on that releases page. An empty answer is FAIL.

ques: Locate a repository on GitHub that was created in the last week and has 50 or more stars. Provide brief details about the project's purpose and its programming language.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. The agent MUST run a search constrained to repositories created in the last week with at least 50 stars, or open a qualifying repository's page. The final answer MUST name one qualifying repository and describe its purpose and its programming language as shown on the mirror. A repository created earlier than the last week or below 50 stars is FAIL. An empty answer is FAIL.

ques: Find a newly created open-source project on GitHub related to 'climate change' that has been initiated in January 2023; check the main programming language used and the project's description.
